kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنهزل (form VII)
# أَنْهَزِلُ (ʔanhazilu) /ʔan.ha.zi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# أَنْهَزِلَ (ʔanhazila) /ʔan.ha.zi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# أَنْهَزِلْ (ʔanhazil) /ʔan.ha.zil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
